Free 16x16 Puny World Tileset

License text from the source page:

"This is a free asset pack!
Feel free to use this for your game (commercially or not).
Feel free to creatively modify these sprites however you like.
No need to give me credit(s)."

The SteambandRedux proof-of-concept atlas uses this asset as a permissive
Ultima-like old-school RPG style reference source. It is not copied, traced, or
derived from Ultima, Balor, Wizardry, or other proprietary game assets.
